text: 1. Photocopy of a valid passport, including the photo, passport number, expiration date, and name. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo of the applicant taken recently. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma The graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and notarized. 4. Undergraduate school transcript 5. Health certificate (optional) A photocopy of the medical examination record. 6. Two recommendation letters From a professor, associate professor, or equivalent 7. Resume Written in Chinese or English 8. Information Form for CUP Foreign Students You can download a sample here: 留学生信息表.doc.
